"""E0-10: one frozen-source dev/test pair on the real 88-request corpus."""
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tomllib

ROOT = Path('/tmp/stele-post278-frontier')
OUT = Path('/tmp/stele-lookup-profile-f2dfd91')
HEAD = 'f2dfd917baf00b8419dbf264c5f3cbdafa052d46'
TREE = '40a363a22c7f2826b41763f2a213a51cea6624f8'
original_run = subprocess.run

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def stamp():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def read(args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()

def clean_source():
    assert read(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == HEAD
    assert read(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}']) == TREE
    assert not read(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'])

clean_source()
overrides = [k for k, v in os.environ.items() if v and (
    k.startswith('CARGO_PROFILE_') or k in {'RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS',
    'CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS', 'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC',
    'CARGO_BUILD_TARGET', 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR'})]
assert not overrides, ('Unexpected compiler override names', overrides)
config = tomllib.loads((ROOT/'Cargo.toml').read_text())
assert config['profile']['test'] == {
    'opt-level': 2, 'debug-assertions': True, 'overflow-checks': True}
assert 'dev' not in config['profile']
OUT.mkdir()
paths = ['Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml',
    'tests/negative-controls/lookup_corpus.py', 'tests/negative-controls/lookup_closed.py',
    'tests/negative-controls/lookup_corpus.py.lock',
    'tests/negative-controls/examples/lookup_corpus.rs']
plan = dict(task='E0-10', source_commit=HEAD, source_tree=TREE,
    source_sha256={p: sha(ROOT/p) for p in paths},
    order=['dev', 'test'], repetitions=1, requests=88,
    build='Separate empty Cargo target directories; ordinary example, locked/offline.',
    execution='One direct complete stdin batch per binary; build and execution disjoint.',
    oracle='Unchanged lookup_corpus.main generates expected inputs/results once and checks every result.',
    qualifications=['Shared macOS host; original workers neither inspected nor manipulated.',
        'One ordered screening pair, without warmups, retries or discarded results.',
        'No statistical, whole-CI, GPU or inference speedup claim.',
        'Reference generation, native compilation and native execution are separate work.',
        'The parent native gate and historical Requant campaigns are not rerun by this measurement.'],
    controller_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), started_at=stamp())
(OUT/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2)+'\n')
results = dict(plan=plan, python=sys.version, host=platform.platform(),
    cpu=read(['sysctl', '-n', 'machdep.cpu.brand_string']),
    rustc=read(['rustc', '--version', '--verbose']), cargo=read(['cargo', '--version']),
    configurations=[], complete=False)

def save():
    (OUT/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2)+'\n')

def run(label, argv, env, request=None):
    stdout, stderr = OUT/(label+'.stdout'), OUT/(label+'.stderr')
    record = dict(label=label, argv=argv, cwd=str(ROOT), started_at=stamp(),
        load_before=[str(x) for x in os.getloadavg()])
    print(json.dumps({'start': label}), file=sys.__stdout__, flush=True)
    start = time.monotonic_ns()
    with stdout.open('xb') as out, stderr.open('xb') as err:
        completed = original_run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, input=request, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    record.update(wall_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-start, exit_code=completed.returncode,
        ended_at=stamp(), load_after=[str(x) for x in os.getloadavg()],
        stdout=str(stdout), stdout_sha256=sha(stdout), stdout_bytes=stdout.stat().st_size,
        stderr=str(stderr), stderr_sha256=sha(stderr), stderr_bytes=stderr.stat().st_size)
    print(json.dumps({'finish': label, 'exit_code': record['exit_code'],
        'wall_ns': record['wall_ns']}), file=sys.__stdout__, flush=True)
    return record

save()
calls = 0
started = time.monotonic_ns()

def native_pair(command, **kwargs):
    global calls
    calls += 1
    assert calls == 1
    assert command == ['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'stele-negative-controls',
        '--example', 'lookup_corpus', '--locked', '--offline']
    assert kwargs['cwd'] == ROOT.resolve() and kwargs['text'] is True and kwargs['capture_output'] is True
    request = kwargs['input'].encode()
    inputs = [json.loads(line) for line in request.splitlines()]
    assert len(inputs) == 88
    (OUT/'requests.jsonl').write_bytes(request)
    results.update(reference_generation_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-started,
        request_sha256=sha(OUT/'requests.jsonl'), request_bytes=len(request),
        request_names=[case['name'] for case in inputs], caller_command=command)
    save()
    outputs, features = [], []
    for profile, level in [('dev', '0'), ('test', '2')]:
        target = OUT/('target-'+profile)
        target.mkdir()
        env_options = {'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': str(target), 'CARGO_TERM_COLOR': 'never'}
        env = dict(os.environ, **env_options)
        item = dict(profile=profile, env=env_options)
        results['configurations'].append(item)
        argv = ['cargo', 'build', '--profile', profile, '-p', 'stele-negative-controls',
            '--example', 'lookup_corpus', '--locked', '--offline', '--verbose', '--message-format=json']
        item['build'] = run(profile+'-build', argv, env)
        save()
        assert item['build']['exit_code'] == 0
        messages = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(item['build']['stdout']).read_text().splitlines()]
        assert any(m['reason'] == 'build-finished' and m['success'] for m in messages)
        artifacts = [m for m in messages if m['reason'] == 'compiler-artifact']
        selected = [m for m in artifacts if m['target']['name'] == 'lookup_corpus'
                    and m['target']['kind'] == ['example'] and m['executable']]
        assert len(selected) == 1
        artifact = selected[0]
        executable = Path(artifact['executable']).resolve()
        assert executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve()) and executable.is_file()
        item.update(artifact=artifact, executable_sha256=sha(executable))
        runtime = [m for m in artifacts if m['target']['name'].startswith('stele_')
                   or m['target']['name'] == 'lookup_corpus']
        assert len(runtime) >= 10
        for m in runtime:
            p = m['profile']
            assert p['opt_level'] == level and p['debug_assertions'] and p['overflow_checks']
            assert p['test'] is False
        graph = {m['target']['name']: sorted(m['features']) for m in runtime}
        assert len(graph) == len(runtime)
        features.append(graph)
        item['runtime_artifacts'] = [dict(name=m['target']['name'], features=m['features'],
            profile=m['profile']) for m in runtime]
        save()
        item['corpus'] = run(profile+'-corpus', [str(executable)], env, request)
        save()
        assert item['corpus']['exit_code'] == 0
        output = Path(item['corpus']['stdout']).read_bytes()
        assert Path(item['corpus']['stderr']).read_bytes() == b''
        assert len(output.splitlines()) == 88
        outputs.append(output)
        assert sha(executable) == item['executable_sha256']
        clean_source()
    assert outputs[0] == outputs[1] and features[0] == features[1]
    results.update(exact_native_output_equal=True, safety_and_features_equal=True)
    save()
    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, 0, stdout=outputs[1].decode(), stderr='')

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/'tests/negative-controls'))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('e010_lookup', ROOT/'tests/negative-controls/lookup_corpus.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
receipt = io.StringIO()
subprocess.run = native_pair
try:
    with redirect_stdout(receipt):
        module.main()
finally:
    subprocess.run = original_run
assert calls == 1
output = receipt.getvalue()
assert len(output.splitlines()) == 3
(OUT/'independent.stdout').write_text(output)
clean_source()
assert plan['source_sha256'] == {p: sha(ROOT/p) for p in paths}
results.update(complete=True, independent_receipt=output,
    independent_receipt_sha256=sha(OUT/'independent.stdout'), ended_at=stamp())
save()
print(json.dumps({'complete': True, 'receipt': str(OUT/'results.json'),
    'sha256': sha(OUT/'results.json')}), flush=True)
